scripts.typecheck:native: bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/router/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/compiler/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/crepus-moonshine/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/adapter-solid/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/framework/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/adapter-conformance/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/deploy-bun/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/deploy-node/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/deploy-cloudflare/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p packages/deploy-vercel/tsconfig.json && bunx tsgo --noEmit -p components/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: bun test packages components examples/bun-server examples/shaders-island examples/hybrid-app packages/adapter-*/test && bun run check:catalog
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run check:packages && bun run check:catalog && bun run check:adapters
